Rank them cheapest first and recommend one. Then draft (1) a short email to Prakash asking for his one-employee monthly payroll rate and start date, and (2) the list of items I need to sign up with the top online option today: EIN, EDD employer account number, bank account for funding, employee W-4 and DE 4, I-9, pay schedule.
